pull_request.title: Calorimeter: test physical module staggering and held-out calibration
pull_request.head: codex/ecal-calibration-staggering-tests
pull_request.body:
Follow-up to #135, stacked on its control study: test physical ECAL board staggering and a frozen reconstructed-position calibration using the exact same 10,000 electrons (uniform total E=10–80 GeV, eta −3..3, full phi) with 12 DDSim workers. This is an isolated PROTOTYPE under DES-030/DES-031; inherited full-depth sector seams remain and production geometry is unchanged.

Inclusive raw SD(R)/mean(R) falls from **43.09% to 39.27%** with staggering. Held-out calibration gives **34.43% / 32.22%** for baseline / staggered geometry, but mean Ecal/Etrue remains **0.9136 / 0.9191**, with **8.99% / 8.54%** gain clipping. The scale bias is retained and prominently reported; this is not a production calibration or an intrinsic fixed-energy resolution measurement. All twenty raw layout-difference pointwise 95% paired intervals are positive; sixteen of twenty calibrated intervals are positive. Sector-seam raw widths remain roughly 105%.

![Four-way angular response comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/4bbd9a9bdfd8813804dc8adeaffda07b03a01b0d/docs/validation/ecal-staggering/results/angular-comparison.png)

Physical half-phase boards carry their actual guards, PCB, electrodes and ASIC/thermal stacks. A declared 24 mm axial adaptation preserves short-slab rows/clearances. Net silicon changes −1.576 kg and total modeled mass +23.156 kg; common absorber/support/cooling and native libraries are retained. No manufacturing, thermal or engineering acceptance is claimed.

Validation: 24 physical/calibration/statistical tests; 551,520 unique native sensitive IDs; 252,484 electrode references; zero overlaps/extrusions at 1e-5 mm; 1,080,360-ray geometric screen per geometry; 24-event 12-worker pilot; full 10,000-primary/6,346,815-hit and all 12-worker readback; unchanged original 20 baseline moments; 1,000 paired whole-event bootstrap replicas with complete nested calibration refits, fixed ID folds and joint 80-width/80-contrast covariance; identical-input zero-contrast integration control. Transport took 591.953 s, peak 2.469 GiB RSS and 12.613 GB ROOT, with no disk reduction. Standalone plotting reproduces all PNG/SVG exports without event files.

The [report](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/ecal-calibration-staggering-tests/docs/validation/ecal-staggering/README.md), [frozen protocol](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/ecal-calibration-staggering-tests/docs/validation/ecal-staggering/protocol.md) and [reproduction recipe](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/ecal-calibration-staggering-tests/docs/validation/ecal-staggering/reproduce.md) include energy-scale, tails, signed-direction/sector and secondary-prior controls. All eight figure families are stored as PNG/PDF/**SVG**. Only figures, recipes, compact binned/aggregate evidence and curated records are published. ROOT, exact primary/event ledgers, full geometry/pad/ray audits and event-level feature/prediction files remain local and ignored. Exact task token counters are unavailable. Independent PhysVal source/statistical assessments found no material defects; final numerical/visual assessment independently checked all 80 angular populations, frozen inference, bindings, covariance and all eight figures without an actionable material finding. Draft only; no design sign-off.

The user explicitly approved draft PR publication to asalzburger/nodd, including source, compact results and PNG/PDF/SVG figures.

[Vector SVG overlay](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/4bbd9a9bdfd8813804dc8adeaffda07b03a01b0d/docs/validation/ecal-staggering/results/angular-comparison.svg).

events.text:
The physical four-phase board layout was frozen before response inspection.
Barrel narrow edge boards preserve envelopes/ASIC capacity; short slabs use a
24 mm quarter-phase to preserve rows/clearance. All area/material changes are
explicit. Native construction/IDs/electrodes/zero-overlap checks, 24-event pilot,
full 10k transport and all saved-primary/hit/12-worker audits pass. The original
sector seams remain. Dense mask screening is geometry only.

The calibration protocol freezes observable-only features, five outer/three
inner ID folds, training-only preprocessing, ridge candidates and gain bounds.
Separate `Model.infer(features, signal)` returns energy without truth inputs;
held-out truth changes leave inferred energy unchanged. No held-out retuning.
The first baseline fit improves global CV from 43.09% to 34.43%, while retaining
mean Ecal/Etrue=0.9136 and 8.99% clipping. This scale bias is a reported limitation,
not removed by an evaluation-derived correction. Final paired analysis follows.
